court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chandauli, Crl. Case No. 136 of 2020
case_name: Tushar Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Tushar Singh and 2 others (husband, wife, plaintiff)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and another (wife, husband, defendant)

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute; parties invoked inherent jurisdiction to quash charge sheet and proceedings in criminal case arising out of crime no. 550 of 2019 under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

legal_principles.principle: An application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. can be entertained if the settlement between the parties is genuine and there are no allegations of coercion, undue influence, or fraud.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court has summarized the ratio of all the cases decided earlier with respect to quashing of F.I.R./charge-sheet/criminal proceeding on the ground of settlement between the parties.
cited_cases: Parbatbhai Aahir alias Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and others Vs. State of Gujarat and another, (2017) AIR 4843
B.S.Joshi & Others Vs. State of Haryana & Others; (2003) 4 SCC 675

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that the settlement between the parties is genuine and there are no allegations of coercion, undue influence, or fraud.
legal_principles.held: The applicants have relied upon the judgments of the Hon'ble Apex Court to support their plea for quashing the criminal proceedings.
cited_cases: B.S.Joshi & Others Vs. State of Haryana & Others; (2003) 4 SCC 675
Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation; (2008) 9 SCC 667

outcome.final_order: Court quashed charge sheet and proceedings in criminal case.
